dlg.arne_intro.speaker: Arne
lines: Mind the water, the bank gives way.
Anything you need hammered, I am here till dusk.

dlg.chest.speaker: A heavy chest
lines: Someone went to real trouble over it.

dlg.crossroads.speaker: Signpost
lines: North: the old tower. East: the mill.
West: quarry - mind the loose stone.
South: more road than anyone needs.

dlg.goat_bleat.speaker: Goat
lines: It stares at you, chewing, entirely unbothered.

dlg.sheep_baa.speaker: Sheep
lines: It goes back to the grass.
RIVERSIDE - north to the ford, south to the old wall.

dlg.statue.speaker: Weathered statue
lines: A figure with its arms held out, worn smooth by rain.
Whoever it was, nobody here remembers.

dlg.well.speaker: The well
lines: The bucket is down there somewhere.
Cold air comes up off the water.
